audit_metadata.title: CHRONOS-X Temporal Safety Remediation — Independent Code Audit
audit_metadata.governance_mode: STRICT READ-ONLY INDEPENDENT SCIENTIFIC & ENGINEERING AUDIT

fail_closed_gate_production.description: Production FusionEngine._classify strictly requires chronos_temporal_eligibility == 'TRUE' before promoting any candidate to NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE. All non-TRUE inputs (FALSE, UNVERIFIABLE, None, missing, invalid string) fall through to ANOMALOUS_RESIDUAL_REQUIRES_REVIEW.

eligibility_contract_verification.unverifiable_handling: Missing timestamps, WCS coordinates, detector identity, variance uncertainty, or quality masks are strictly classified as UNVERIFIABLE with structured missing_evidence provenance.

baseline_policy_verification.same_visit_override: Verified. Sequences within same visit or dt < 30 min are classified as is_dither=True and temporal_eligibility='FALSE'.

invariants_confirmed: E4 completeness does not require a multi-day baseline.
Intra-visit dithers achieve E4 while remaining temporal_eligibility='FALSE'.
Missing uncertainty or quality masks caps tier at E3 or lower.
Evidence tiers and temporal eligibility are independently serialized.

alternate_prototype_pathway_qualificatio.description: Prototype class FusionRanker.classify_candidate contains an un-gated legacy heuristic: 'if temporal_sig > 5.0 and not is_known_star: return NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE'. While not called by the active production pipeline (which uses models/fusion/fusion_engine.py), it should be deprecated or updated to prevent future regression.

minimal_remediation_recommendations: In models/fusion_x/model.py, deprecate or add temporal_eligibility check to FusionRanker.classify_candidate to unify the prototype module with models/fusion/fusion_engine.py.
Retain dataset-level status as TEMPORAL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE until genuine multi-epoch Level-2 FITS files (e.g. Weeks 31-32) are retrieved from IRSA.
